labels.gloss: anticipatory dread about an outcome that has not arrived yet
labels.probe: restless worry about how something will turn out, obsessing over consequences you cannot control, dread about a decision still ahead

labels.gloss: dread of a specific threat, including death and loss
labels.probe: fear of what is coming, terror of dying, dread of losing what you have or the people you love

labels.gloss: doubt about one's own adequacy or standing
labels.probe: feeling not good enough, comparing yourself with others and coming up short, fear that you will be found out

labels.gloss: sorrow at loss, especially of people
labels.probe: mourning someone who has died, the ache of absence, sorrow over things that cannot be undone

labels.gloss: collapse of the will to act; Arjuna's state in chapter one
labels.probe: feeling that nothing you do matters, wanting to put down your responsibilities and withdraw from everything

labels.gloss: having no agency over one's own situation
labels.probe: being unable to change what is happening to you, watching events you cannot influence, powerlessness over your circumstances

labels.gloss: depletion; the weariness that precedes giving up
labels.probe: burnout from carrying something too long, having nothing left to give, being tired in a way that sleep does not fix

labels.gloss: isolation; being unaccompanied in one's situation
labels.probe: feeling that nobody understands what you are going through, being surrounded by people and still alone

labels.gloss: judgment about the kind of person one is
labels.probe: feeling fundamentally unworthy, wanting to hide who you are, believing something is wrong with you rather than with what you did

labels.gloss: remorse about a specific act or failure to act
labels.probe: regret over something you did or failed to do, wishing you had chosen differently, the weight of having let someone down

labels.gloss: hostility arising from thwarted desire
labels.probe: anger at someone who wronged you, resentment that keeps returning, irritation you cannot put down

labels.gloss: agitation from repeated blocked effort
labels.probe: trying again and again and getting the same result, effort that goes nowhere, being blocked by things outside your control

labels.gloss: inability to settle the mind
labels.probe: a mind that will not be still, jumping between thoughts, unable to concentrate or sit with yourself

labels.gloss: being bound by obligation or circumstance
labels.probe: feeling trapped in a role you cannot leave, obligations that hold you in place, a life shaped by duties you did not choose

labels.gloss: delusion; not seeing the situation as it is
labels.probe: not being able to tell what is actually happening, feeling lost, unable to separate what is real from what you told yourself

labels.gloss: inability to settle on what is true or right
labels.probe: second-guessing your path, unable to commit to a decision, wondering whether any of this is true

labels.gloss: attachment to obtaining a particular outcome
labels.probe: wanting something badly, craving recognition or possession or success, unable to let go of an outcome you have fixed on

labels.gloss: yearning toward something absent or higher
labels.probe: missing something you cannot name, yearning for meaning or for God, homesickness for a place you have not been

labels.gloss: resentment at another's good fortune
labels.probe: watching someone else get what you wanted, comparing your life against theirs, bitterness at another's success

labels.gloss: inflated self-regard; identification with one's own status
labels.probe: needing to be seen as the one who did it, taking things personally because your standing is at stake, superiority

labels.gloss: the steady state the text points toward
labels.probe: steadiness that does not depend on outcomes, acceptance, the relief of having finally let something go, peace

labels.gloss: love and surrender directed toward the divine
labels.probe: loving devotion, giving yourself over to something greater, trust that does not require you to understand everything

labels.gloss: determination to act despite difficulty
labels.probe: steadiness of purpose, the decision to keep going, commitment that survives discouragement

labels.gloss: intellectual longing rather than distress
labels.probe: wanting to understand how things actually are, philosophical curiosity, asking what the self or the world really is
